task_name: Anvil and Oak Strength - Movement coaching clip library
client_brief:
Anvil and Oak is not ready to cut the full coaching library yet: our demo pack does not carry a complete repetition in every angle we need, and we are not going to loop a take to pretend otherwise. What we need from you now is the launch package that puts the library in front of subscribers. Cut it short, cut it silent or to the bed we supply, and put the coaching on screen as text, because a lifter under a bar watches with the sound off. The movement names and the cues must read exactly as they are written in the cleared library sheet, and the framing and the lifter must agree across all three films.

Final handoff
1. Movement library launch reel: 1 named export, 16:9, 12 to 15 seconds, instrumental bed only, no speech. All six cleared movement names appear as on screen text, and at least one movement carries its cue line.
2. Vertical library cutdown: 1 named export, 9:16, 8 to 9 seconds, silent, no audio track at all. The barbell stays inside the frame for every repetition shown.
3. Square library cutdown: 1 named export, 1:1, 6 to 8 seconds, silent, no audio track at all. The wordmark closes the film.

The per movement demonstrations we asked for previously are withdrawn from this commission and will be re briefed once the source pack carries full coverage.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Every film in this package is silent or carries the supplied instrumental bed only. There is no narration, no voice over and no spoken claim: the message is carried by on screen text that you set.
- Every supplied clip runs about five seconds. Each film must cut at least three distinct supplied shots, and no film may be padded by looping, freezing or slowing a single clip to reach its runtime.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Subscription strength training app with a coached movement library, sold direct to home gym subscribers.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Providence, Rhode Island; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Anvil and Oak Strength is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Providence, Rhode Island, and this commission covers phase 2: coached movement video library.
brand_identity.audience: Subscribers aged 30 to 52 with a home or garage gym, already lifting and paying for instruction rather than motivation. They can tell a coach from a cheerleader and buy the difference.
brand_identity.price_positioning: 49 dollars a month, coached strength, extended a quarter at a time. Positioned as a working coach's studio: clearly above a 9 dollar mass fitness app and deliberately clear of a clinical or rehabilitation register.
brand_identity.typography: Anvil and Oak Strength runs Trade Gothic for display and Benton Sans for text. Step 01, Display / H1, is Trade Gothic Bold Condensed No. 20 capitals at 96 px on 60 px leading, tracking -0.01 em, carrying movement names on the wide reel, for example ROMANIAN DEADLIFT forced onto two flush left rows, the leading being 0.86 of the 70 px cap height, with a 3 px Ember Rust rule under the lower row at that row's exact width, and 34 pt on 21 pt on the printed card. Step 02, Subheading / H2, is the same face at 72 px on 45 px leading, tracking -0.01 em, for the square cutdown, for example FRONT SQUAT, again on two rows under the rust rule. Step 03, Body, is Benton Sans Medium 500 at 48 px on 67 px leading, tracking 0, max 65 characters, carrying coaching cues at 1.4 spacing, 56 px on 78 px in the vertical cutdown and 10.5 pt on 15 pt in print. Step 04, Fine print, is Benton Sans Medium 500 at 28 px on 38 px leading, tracking +0.04 em, numerals tabular lining, 8 pt on 11 pt in print. A movement name is never set on one line.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, instructional and calm. Speaks like a coach giving a cue, not a brand selling one. Example line: 'Brace, hinge, drive through the floor. That is the whole lift.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark and the in house certification seal survive only as stitching on a canvas gym bag patch, held now as one handheld photograph. Both have to be recovered from that photograph as artwork before they can go on the cards and the library sheet. The seal is a compound ring lockup, type set around a central anvil glyph inside a ruled ring. There is no vector file, no colour spec and no prior guideline.
brand_identity.values: Competence and honesty: real bodies doing real work, taught by people who actually lift.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every movement name is forced onto two lines whatever its length, flush left with leading at 0.86 of the cap height so the rows almost touch, and a 3 px Ember Rust rule pinned under the lower line at exactly that line's width.

scale.note: Capitals on the wide reel, forced onto two flush left rows as ROMANIAN / DEADLIFT. Leading is 0.86 of the 70 px cap height, so the rows almost touch. A 3 px Ember Rust rule pins under the lower row at that row's exact width. 34 pt on 21 pt on the printed card.
Square cutdown. Same forced two row break and the same 0.86 cap height leading, with the 3 px rust rule cut to the lower row.

scale.sample: Brace, hinge, drive through the floor.
scale.note: Coaching cues at 1.4 spacing. 56 px on 78 px in the vertical cutdown, 10.5 pt on 15 pt in print.

scale.sample: 49 dollars a month, extended a quarter at a time
scale.note: Numerals tabular lining. 8 pt on 11 pt in print.

type_system.signature_move: A forced two line break. Every movement name at steps 01 and 02 stacks on two rows whatever its length, flush left, with leading at 0.86 of the cap height so the rows almost touch, and a 3 px Ember Rust rule pinned under the lower row at exactly that row's width.
rules: Never set a movement name on one line.
Movement names are capitals, flush left, on two rows, leading at 0.86 of the cap height.
The 3 px Ember Rust rule sits under the lower row only, cut to that row's exact width.
Cue copy speaks like a coach giving a cue, never a cheerleader.
Clearly above a mass fitness app and deliberately clear of a clinical register.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
